bundle.shortDescription: A ten-module creative suite built with Rust and Tauri.
bundle.longDescription: ArtCraft Studio is an open-source creative suite with ten modules for photography, vector art, film, writing, decks, design, effects, lighting, grids and PDFs, connected by a shared Rust clipboard.
